items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Oh, Lethia Parker? No, no. That's my granddaughter's daughter.

ctx.x: What's your name? Huh? What's your name?

Lethia. Lethia. Lethia. Lethia. Uh huh. Oh, Lethia Parker? No, no. That's my granddaughter's daughter. Oh, I see. So, you had two altos, three trumpets, trombone, baritone, and you were playing clarinet? Yeah. And your brother Joe played tuba? Tuba, Joe probably, yeah. And we're missing the drums. Joe Martin and Matt Creole. Oh, Joe Martin played snare or?
Joe Martin played snare and Matt Creole played the bass drum.
